issuing_body: U.S. Attorney's Office, District of Minnesota
title: 78th Defendant Charged in Feeding Our Future Fraud Scheme
supports: USAO-MN identifies Abdirashid Bixi Dool, age 36, as the 78th defendant charged in the Feeding Our Future fraud scheme.

Dool was charged in a seven-count indictment with wire fraud and money laundering arising from meal-site claims associated with Bilaal Mosque Inc. and Multicultural Resource Center Inc. in Pelican Rapids and Moorhead.
The release states Dool made his initial appearance in federal court on November 24, 2025.
does_not_support: This release does not establish who became the 79th or 80th defendant.
Charging allegations are not adjudicated facts.
notes: The official USAO page is directly accessible as of 2026-08-30. This closes the prior access gap that had preserved the 78th-defendant page only as an Akamai-blocked URL lead.
